issues.quote: R&D expense increasing to $29.5 million in fiscal 2024 from $27.2 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Unit error: fiscal 2024 R&D was $29.5 billion, not $29.5 million. As written, it reads as a roughly 99.9% drop, which contradicts the word 'increasing'.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, operating income, margins, net income, growth rates and EPS all match Microsoft's FY2024 results. The one error is that FY2024 R&D is given as $29.5 million instead of $29.5 billion.
